Lena (Finance Ops): Spectral.ai INV-2025-204 hasn't been paid; 58 days past due, card declined 2025-10-12. Customer emailed asking for a short-term arrangement and asked to avoid service interruption. Thoughts?

Marco (Account Executive): I spoke with Priya (their finance lead). They hit a timing issue with venture finance closing. Priya proposes: 25% now, 25% in 30d, 50% in 60d. Wants late fees waived if plan accepted.

Sam (Collections): We prefer either 50/50 or the 3-installment 40/30/30 we usually do. 25/25/50 increases risk. Need signed PO or CFO email + payment method proof.

Lena (Finance Ops): No PO in portal. Priya said CFO can send an email approval and they'll wire the first tranche today if we accept terms.

Olga (Collections Lead): Conditions: (1) PO uploaded to billing@redwood.com, (2) CFO email acknowledging schedule, (3) first wire within 48h. We'll label account "on-plan" and waive late fees retroactively only after first payment posts. If any condition fails, suspend in 7 days. Also apply a 0.75% admin fee monthly on outstanding.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2025-204 | Amount: $61,200 | Due: 2025-08-20 | Status: Past due (58d) | Last payment: none | Payment method: card (failed 2025-10-12)

Marco (Account Executive): Customer sent PO screenshot and CFO email draft. They request the admin fee be called an "account maintenance charge" to match internal language.

Sam (Collections): Admin fee label fine. Need the actual PO file sent to billing@redwood.com and wire receipt.

Priya (Spectral.ai): Confirming CFO emailed and PO attached to my message. Wire for 15,300 (25%) initiated, bank gave a same-day transfer ref 47-9921. I'll upload the receipt in 1hr. We appreciate the flexibility.

Lena (Finance Ops): Received wire confirmation 6 hours later for $15,300. Marked partial payment. Created payment plan spectral-25-25-50-INV-2025-204 and set reminders for 30/60 days.

Olga (Collections Lead): Logged plan in collections tracker, assigned to Sam. Waived accrued late fees up to today's date. Next payment must post by 30 days or we escalate to legal.

Marco (Account Executive): Customer sent thanks. I'll keep working with them to ensure the round closes.

Sam (Collections): Note for audit: all communications and receipts saved to ticket #COL-2025-987. If next payment misses, start suspension + legal escalation.

Lena (Finance Ops): Thread resolved for now. Keeping records for audit and closing loop unless something changes.
